notation.qaloop:<name>: one of the 18 points of tools/qaloop_gates.py LANDMARKS, as grid/autoanatomist/autoanatomist/oracle.py places it
notation.engine:<module.function>: a construction of the vendored morphometry engine, grid/bordercall/morphometry
notation.fixed: one place on the bone, the same in every view
notation.silhouette: where the bone's outline turns in the view read; a fixed 3-D point stands for it only near that view
notation.held: the path under the grid's data root, or false

landmarks.name: FH-l, FH-r
landmarks.definition: centers of the femoral head

landmarks.name: GSN-l, GSN-r
landmarks.definition: greater sciatic notches
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: the notch's deepest point on the ilium's posterior border

landmarks.name: IOF-l, IOF-r
landmarks.definition: inferior obturator foramen
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: the obturator foramen's lowest rim point

landmarks.name: MOF-l, MOF-r
landmarks.definition: medial obturator foramen
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: the obturator foramen's most medial rim point

landmarks.name: SPS-l, SPS-r
landmarks.definition: superior pubis symphysis

landmarks.name: IPS-l, IPS-r

landmarks.name: ASIS-l, ASIS-r

datasets.name: Mendeley 5jdfdgp762
datasets.format: JSON for Keypoint R-CNN (boxes, keypoints 4 per vertebra as x, y, visibility, labels) and YOLO pose text (class, box, 4 keypoints with flags), both in Train/Keypointrcnn_data/labels/train and labels/val; the 16 films in Test carry none. Keypoint order, measured against BUU-LSPINE's line ends on 501 films (job 40940634): JSON the lower plate's two corners, then the upper plate's; text the upper plate's first, the lower plate's two, the upper plate's second; each plate's corners in the order of BUU's line ends
datasets.note: 698 labelled films: 484 in JSON (13,000 keypoints) and 214 in YOLO pose text (1,350 vertebrae); 3 to 11 vertebrae a film, more than L3 to S1 on most; 16 unlabelled test films; 501 films carry a BUU-LSPINE lateral film's name and are a second placement of BUU's corners: on 2,466 L1 to L5 bodies the corners lie a median 9.3 BUU pixels (4 per cent of the plate's length) from BUU's line ends, no film's shift and no copy (jobs 40940634, 40940650)

landmarks.counterpart_3d: engine:column.wall_corner(bottom); its nearest LANDMARK qaloop:endplate_lower_depth.posterior lies a median 0.3 mm in front of it along the depth and 3.7 mm inside the body along the plate's normal (job 40940609)
landmarks.fixed_or_silhouette: silhouette (in a true lateral the midline corner stands in; where the posterior face is concave across the outline's corner may lie behind it, unmeasured)

landmarks.name: upper plate middle
landmarks.definition: the middle of the upper end-plate (sets Hm with the lower)
landmarks.counterpart_3d: engine:column.plate_centre(top)

landmarks.name: lower plate middle
landmarks.definition: the middle of the lower end-plate
landmarks.counterpart_3d: engine:column.plate_centre(bottom)

datasets.name: SOF lateral spine films
datasets.format: six points per body, T4 to L4; Genant grades
datasets.note: asked; registration closed; images moving to the NIA Aging Research Biobank

datasets.name: MrOS lateral spine films
datasets.format: 6-point and 95-point morphometry by semi-automated software; Genant grades

schemes.name: The spinopelvic points and the sagittal vertical axis
schemes.citation: Legaye J, Duval-Beaupere G, Hecquet J, Marty C. Pelvic incidence: a fundamental pelvic parameter for three-dimensional regulation of spinal sagittal curves. Eur Spine J 1998;7(2):99-103. Schwab F, Ungar B, Blondel B, et al. Scoliosis Research Society-Schwab adult spinal deformity classification: a validation study. Spine 2012;37(12):1077-1082. doi:10.1097/BRS.0b013e31823e15e2

landmarks.name: S1 plate, anterior end
landmarks.definition: the anterior end of the sacral plate
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: the S1 plate's anterior end
landmarks.fixed_or_silhouette: silhouette (near fixed on the midline in a true lateral)

landmarks.name: S1 plate, posterior end
landmarks.definition: the posterior end of the sacral plate; the posterosuperior corner of S1
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: the S1 plate's posterior end
landmarks.fixed_or_silhouette: silhouette (in a true lateral the midline corner stands in; where the posterior face is concave across the outline's corner may lie behind it, unmeasured)

landmarks.name: S1 plate midpoint
landmarks.definition: the middle of the S1 plate, where incidence is read
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: the middle of the S1 plate's two ends (the centre of engine:pelvis.s1_plate is the mean of the sacral top under the lowest lumbar body's footprint, so it moves with L5 and in a slip is not the reader's midpoint)

landmarks.name: femoral head centres
landmarks.definition: the centres of the two femoral heads; the hip axis is their middle
landmarks.counterpart_3d: engine:pelvis.socket_centre

landmarks.name: C7 centre
landmarks.definition: the centre of the C7 body, from which the plumb line drops
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: the centroid of anatomy.build's C7 body

datasets.name: none held with a reader's spinopelvic points
datasets.note: BUU-LSPINE's lateral S1 line gives the S1 plate's two ends without the femoral heads

schemes.name: The Cobb end-plate lines
schemes.citation: Cobb JR. Outline for the study of scoliosis. AAOS Instructional Course Lectures, vol. 5. Ann Arbor: J. W. Edwards; 1948:261-275 (as cited; text not read)

landmarks.name: upper end vertebra's superior plate line
landmarks.definition: a line along the superior end-plate of the upper end vertebra
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: on an anteroposterior film the line through the plate's two lateral corners, qaloop:endplate.right to qaloop:endplate.left; engine:column.plate_normal(top) and engine:column.coronal_cobb take their slope across from the plane of engine:body.rim_plane through the plate's central half, not from its corners; on a lateral the line from corner to corner is the slope front to back of engine:body.rim_plane

landmarks.name: lower end vertebra's inferior plate line
landmarks.definition: a line along the inferior end-plate of the lower end vertebra
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: on an anteroposterior film the line through the plate's two lateral corners, qaloop:endplate_lower.right to qaloop:endplate_lower.left; engine:column.plate_normal(bottom) and engine:column.coronal_cobb take their slope across from the plane of engine:body.rim_plane through the plate's central half, not from its corners; on a lateral the line from corner to corner is the slope front to back of engine:body.rim_plane

schemes.name: Rotation from the pedicles (Nash-Moe, Perdriolle)
schemes.citation: Nash CL, Moe JH. A study of vertebral rotation. J Bone Joint Surg Am 1969;51:223-229. Perdriolle R, Vidal J. Thoracic idiopathic scoliosis curve evolution and prognosis. Spine 1985;10(9):785-791 (PubMed 4089651)

landmarks.name: convex pedicle oval's centre
landmarks.definition: the position of the convex-side pedicle's shadow within the body's width
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: the projection of the pedicle module's isthmus axis

landmarks.name: body's lateral margins at the pedicle's height
landmarks.definition: the body's two sides that bound the width the pedicle is read in
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: the projected body's outline at the pedicle's height

schemes.name: The slip of L5 on S1 (Meyerding)
schemes.citation: Meyerding HW. Spondyloptosis. Surg Gynecol Obstet 1932;54:371-377 (as cited; text not read)

landmarks.name: L5 posteroinferior corner
landmarks.definition: the corner of L5 the slip is measured to
landmarks.counterpart_3d: engine:column.wall_corner(L5, bottom); not h_post's inferior end, which lies a median 4.7 mm in front of that corner at the lumbar plates (job 40940609)
landmarks.fixed_or_silhouette: silhouette (in a true lateral the midline corner stands in; where the posterior face is concave across the outline's corner may lie behind it, unmeasured)

landmarks.name: S1 posterior wall line
landmarks.definition: the line of the posterior cortex of the S1 body
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: S1's posterior wall (S1 is no vertebra in the engine)

landmarks.name: S1 plate depth
landmarks.definition: the anteroposterior diameter of the S1 plate the slip is a share of
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: the S1 plate's two ends
landmarks.fixed_or_silhouette: silhouette (near fixed on the midline in a true lateral)
